def count_rotation(arr):
    """
    Count the number of rotations required to generate a sorted array.
    The input array is assumed to be a rotated version of a sorted array
    (in ascending order). Returns the index of the minimum element,
    which equals the number of rotations.
    """
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 0:
        return 0

    lo, hi = 0, n - 1

    # If the array is already sorted (no rotation)
    if arr[lo] <= arr[hi]:
        return 0

    while lo <= hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        prev = (mid - 1 + n) % n
        nxt = (mid + 1) % n

        # Minimum element condition
        if arr[mid] <= arr[prev] and arr[mid] <= arr[nxt]:
            return mid

        # Decide which half to search
        if arr[mid] <= arr[hi]:
            hi = mid - 1
        else:
            lo = mid + 1

    return 0
